The same applies when a release is blocked by a newly opened position (reservation + positionId). This can block the 4th trade wrongly until the slot is marked or released (once marked placed with positionId, the pending key disappears on fill). Fail-closed. Fix: link the reservation to orderId/positionId at place time (mark with orderId) and dedupe.
STALE_SLOT_BLOCKED_BY_UNRELATED: any pending order with an unknown instrumentId blocks every stale release, and a same-instrument manual trade blocks release of an unrelated stale slot. Conservative.
